text:
ColliePWA[1] a mobile interface to continue working with your agents when you're on the. Trying to meet devs where they work on the desktop in multiplexers (herdr/tmux/zellij). Remote access can be set up with any front door like tailscale.

Still not sure where this is going as the space is super crowded and moving fast, but it's solving a lot of my own problems and doesn't rely on third parties to run.

[1] https://colliepwa.dev
